items.q: Do I need to install software at every counter?
items.a: No. TIKETI runs in the browser: a computer with an internet connection is enough. Data is centralized and accessible according to each user's permissions.

items.q: Does ticket printing require specific equipment?
items.a: A Bluetooth thermal printer is enough. TIKETI prints the ticket with a QR code and automatically falls back to browser printing.

items.q: Does each company get a separate space?
items.a: Yes. Each company has an isolated space with its own data: stations, vehicles, users and tickets.

items.q: Can I sell a trip with a vehicle change?
items.a: Yes. Connections allow a single ticket for a combined trip, with passenger tracking at the transit station and automatic seat allocation.
